{{- /* Overrides Hextra's llms.txt to use each page's front matter description,
which is written for this purpose, instead of a truncated summary. */ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ .Site.Params.description }}

{{ range where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{ end }}

{{- $rootPages := where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}
## More
{{- range $rootPages }}
{{ template "llms-entry" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "llms-entry" -}}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ .Description | default (.Summary | plainify | truncate 160) | strings.TrimSpace }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-section-tree" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- "\n" -}}
{{ strings.Repeat $level "#" }} {{ $context.Title }}
{{- range where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-entry" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
